concept: A web address as a key with a manila key tag, rendered in 3D (Blender). A made-up florist has two keys: one tag stamped wrenfield.com, the other wrenfield.co.uk. Which one? Low and close on the .co.uk tag: it says UK. Then both keys threaded on one ring: get both, and point the .com at the .co.uk so no one else can have it. Graphite slab, manila card, brass, a steel ring, blue-black stamp ink and one ice blue in the type.
